title: VISIUM TECHNOLOGIES, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Visium Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 1,597,868 shares of Series D Callable Convertible Preferred Stock to approximately 40 accredited investors on April 14, 2026, in exchange for cancellation of $1,597,868.39 in outstanding indebtedness. The preferred stock carries a $1.00 stated value, 3% cumulative dividend, and is convertible into common stock at $0.05 per share.
key_points: Company issued 1,597,868 shares of Series D Preferred Stock on April 14, 2026 to settle $1,597,868.39 of debt
Issuance was made to approximately 40 accredited investors including certain officers
Each preferred share has a $1.00 Stated Value with 3% per annum cumulative dividend
Shares are convertible at holder's option at a fixed Conversion Price of $0.05 per share
Transaction relied on Section 4(a)(2) exemption and Rule 506 of Regulation D for private placement
Board adopted Certificate of Designation designating 2,000,000 shares of new preferred stock series
